line: Out in the world: the land
giver: The world itself: each quest stays hidden until the player finds its place, item or biome, then appears with a toast. A few point back to an organisation in the nearest village.
feel: Stumbling on something strange on the road: a short, self-contained story per place, most of them one sitting long. Dangerous dungeons wait for the right act; small places and biomes are for anyone.

quests.title: The Toll Road
quests.summary: Entering a bandit village, the player finds a merchant held for a toll he can't pay. Clear out the bandits and their leader, then walk the freed merchant to the nearest village, where he sells at cost for good.
quests.reward: Attack XP, a Spartan iron halberd, emeralds

quests.title: Ring Both Bells
quests.summary: The bandit towers signal each other with bells; ring the bell on top of each tower within a minute of the other while archers shoot from the walkways, and the towers' lookouts flee, leaving their stash.
quests.reward: Range XP, a Supplementaries quiver, arrows

quests.title: The Great Cage
quests.summary: A giant aviary stands open on the mountainside with its keepers long gone. Climb its tiers, clear what nests there now and free three caged birds (parrots or Alex's Mobs birds) before they starve.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a Domestication Innovation collar tag, feathers

quests.title: Steam and Shadows
quests.summary: The bathhouse's pools still steam, and something lurks under the water. Clear the halls, then find the bath master's ledger that names who drowned here and why.
quests.reward: Defense XP, Supplementaries soap, a stack of towels and bread

quests.title: The Foundry's Last Blueprint
quests.summary: The foundry's furnaces have gone cold but its blueprints survive. Fight past its guardians, recover the master smith's plans and forge the piece they describe at a smithing table back home.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a Spartan Shields iron tower shield, iron blocks

quests.title: The Siege of Keep Kayra
quests.summary: Keep Kayra's garrison went mad and still holds the walls. Fight up through the gatehouse and towers to the keep's lord, then hold the throne room against his last wave.
quests.reward: Defense XP, an enchanted Spartan diamond longsword, a banner of the keep

quests.title: The Clockwork Hive
quests.summary: The mechanical nest hums with things that aren't quite alive. Hunt its guardians until one drops a Mainspring (quest item), the heart of the hive, and bring it to a Crafters' guild mason to study.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, redstone and copper blocks

quests.title: Samples from the Asylum
quests.summary: The plague asylum's wards still hold the sick and what feeds on them. Slip in, collect three samples from its apothecary and brew the cure from its notes, which the Herbalists want a copy of.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, HerbalBrews teas, potions of healing

quests.title: The Palace Treasury
quests.summary: Shiraz Palace's treasury is sealed behind a riddle in tiles. Explore the palace, read the mosaics in each court and set the treasury's levers in the order they tell.
quests.reward: Attack XP, gold blocks, an enchanted golden apple

quests.title: The Thornborn Ascent
quests.summary: Thorns have swallowed the Thornborn Towers from the roots up. Climb to the top while the vines' guardians fight back, and bring down a cutting of the first thorn.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, rare saplings, an enchanted axe

quests.title: Swarming Stones
quests.summary: Every wall of the infested temple hides silverfish. Reach the inner sanctum and smash its brood stones within five minutes, before the swarm closes the way out.
quests.reward: Mining XP, an efficiency book, torches

quests.title: The Vow of Silence
quests.summary: The monastery's last monk keeps a vow of silence and talks only in written notes. Carry his sealed letter to a librarian of the Arcane order, and bring back the reply he's waited years for.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a book of a random spell school, candles

quests.title: The Old Order's Temple
quests.summary: An abandoned temple keeps the old order's altar intact. Find the four offerings its inscriptions name in its side rooms and lay them on the altar to open the reliquary.
quests.reward: Magic XP, lapis, an enchanted book

quests.title: The Spore Folk
quests.summary: A village built inside giant mushrooms trades in caps and spores. Trade with its people and learn to grow their mushrooms, bringing back a full set of mushroom blocks.
quests.reward: Farming XP, Farmer's Delight mushroom colonies, mushroom stew

quests.title: The Lonely Cap
quests.summary: A single mushroom house stands far from anywhere, its owner missing. Follow the spore trail from his doorstep to a cave where he's trapped by spiders, and lead him home.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, suspicious stew, mushroom seeds

quests.title: The House in the Canopy
quests.summary: A tree house sits high in the jungle canopy with no ladder left. Climb up by vines and branches (ParCool helps) and claim the lookout's chest at the top.
quests.reward: Agility XP, cocoa beans, a spyglass

quests.title: Fire in the Hole
quests.summary: The scorched mines burn and the last shift never came up. Find the trapped miners through the heat (fire resistance helps) and get them out before the next collapse.
quests.reward: Mining XP, potions of fire resistance, gold ore

quests.title: Empty Stands
quests.summary: The coliseum's stands are empty but its gates still open for a challenger. A note pinned to the gate sends the player to the Bounty office, who know who runs the fights now.
quests.reward: Attack XP, a bounty decree

quests.title: Tea at the Witch Villa
quests.summary: The witches of the swamp villa are holding a tea party and their recipe book is on the table. Sneak in, copy the book (or steal it), and brew their strangest potion yourself.
quests.reward: Magic XP, splash potions, a cauldron

quests.title: Survey of a Fallen Town
quests.summary: A whole town lies in ruins. Survey it: find the town hall, the smithy and the well, and bring back the town's stone to the Crafters' guild, who mean to rebuild it one day.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, stone bricks, a map

quests.title: Stilts over the Swamp
quests.summary: Villagers live on stilts over the swamp water and fish from their porches. Trade with them and catch the swamp's three fish they ask for in return for a boat.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, an Aquaculture iron rod, a mangrove boat

quests.title: The Old Manor
quests.summary: The old manor's doors lock behind the player, and the portraits move at night. Find the four keys hidden behind the portraits and open the study where the family's last letter waits.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a Supplementaries key and safe, gold

quests.title: The Chapel in the Pines
quests.summary: An abandoned chapel still has a bell but no rope. Bring rope and candles to restore it, ring it at dusk, and see who comes out of the forest.
quests.reward: Defense XP, Candlelight candles, a bell

quests.title: The Outcasts
quests.summary: Villagers cast out of their village live in a shack on their own. Hear their side, then carry their apology (and a gift) back to the nearest village, and see if they're welcome again.
quests.reward: Defense XP, emeralds, a cheaper trade at that village

quests.title: Northern Runes
quests.summary: Northern ruins carry runes on their standing stones. Read three of them (in three different ruins) and the words combine into a direction to a buried chest.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a treasure chest, an Explorer's Compass

quests.title: The Temple on the Peak
quests.summary: An ancient temple sits on a mountain peak above the clouds. Climb to it without flying, light its four braziers and watch the sun rise from the top.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a Grappling Hook, golden carrots

quests.title: The Engineer's Plans
quests.summary: The mangrove engineer left plans for a machine half-built. Gather the parts listed in his notes and finish it: a working piston door built from his drawing.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, pistons, redstone

quests.title: The Great Toadstool
quests.summary: A toadstool the size of a tower grows on a mushroom island. Climb inside, find the hermit's room under the cap and take one of his spore jars home to plant.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, mycelium, mushroom stew

quests.title: The Mirage
quests.summary: The desert outpost keeps a water barrel and a logbook of travellers who never arrived. Cross the dunes to the next oasis before your water runs out (a timed run) and add your name to the log.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a water flask (potions of water breathing) and dried food

quests.title: Overgrown
quests.summary: A mangrove tower has been swallowed by roots. Search the roots for the gardener's seed tin and collect the three mangrove plants listed on its lid.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, BloomingNature saplings

quests.title: Jungle Quarters
quests.summary: A jungle outpost has been taken over by ocelots and worse. Clear the camp of hostile mobs without harming the ocelots, then reclaim the quartermaster's chest.
quests.reward: Range XP, arrows, cocoa

quests.title: The Sacred Relic
quests.summary: The relic temple's altar is empty; its relic was taken by the jungle's thieves. Track the relic to a nearby ruin and return it to its altar to wake the temple.
quests.reward: Magic XP, emeralds, a lapis block

quests.title: The Sword in the Hill
quests.summary: A giant warped sword is driven into the shattered hills, as if dropped from the Nether. Climb its blade and find the forger's mark on the hilt, which names its maker.
quests.reward: Attack XP, a Spartan greatsword, warped fungus

quests.title: The Cathedral
quests.summary: A cathedral stands alone in the wilds, its bell tower cracked. Climb the tower, ring the bell, and a cleric arrives to say why the town around it never got built.
quests.reward: Magic XP, an Immersive Melodies piano, golden apples

quests.title: Gallows Hill
quests.summary: A notice on the gallows names a thief who swore he was innocent. Find the real culprit's dropped coin purse nearby and clear the dead man's name with the Village watch.
quests.reward: Defense XP, emeralds

quests.title: The Strategist's Gate
quests.summary: An old gate carries lines from a book of war. Read them all, then win a fight against a pack of mobs using only the terrain the gate describes: high ground, water, fire.
quests.reward: Attack XP, a book of Sharpness, a banner

quests.title: Grove of Remembrance
quests.summary: A monument to a felled forest stands on bare ground. Plant a sapling of every vanilla tree around it and bone-meal them up, and the grove returns.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, bone meal, a stack of saplings

quests.title: Towers of the Wild
quests.summary: Lone towers dot the wilds, each with a view. Climb three different kinds (diorite, red, jungle) and mark each summit on a map.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a spyglass, a filled map

quests.title: Nobody's Home
quests.summary: Lonely houses stand empty along the roads, tables still set. Search three of them for pages of the same diary and learn where the families went.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, Handcrafted furniture, a bed

quests.title: Wrong Side of the Portal
quests.summary: Warped wood houses and towers stand in the Overworld where nothing warped should grow. Collect a sample of their wood and take it to the Arcane order, who suspect a leak from the Nether.
quests.reward: Magic XP, warped planks, an ender pearl

quests.title: The Reading Garden
quests.summary: A lectern stands in a taiga garden with a book open on it. Read the riddle on its last page and find its answer among the garden's flowers.
quests.reward: Magic XP, an enchanted book, bookshelves

quests.title: A Beacon Gone Dark
quests.summary: A ruined beacon still has its pyramid, half-robbed. Replace the missing blocks and light it again, and see the beam from miles away.
quests.reward: Mining XP, iron blocks, a beacon effect chosen at the ruin

quests.title: Too Good to Be True
quests.summary: A desert ruin with an unguarded chest in plain sight. The chest bites: beat the mimic, and the real loot is under the sand where it sat.
quests.reward: Attack XP, gold, a golden horse armour

quests.title: The Pharaoh's Vault
quests.summary: The desert temple's tomb is sealed, and its corridors are trapped. Find the hidden levers, survive the pressure plates and open the pharaoh's vault.
quests.reward: Attack XP, gold, an enchanted book

quests.title: Traps of the Jungle Temple
quests.summary: A jungle temple's halls are full of dart traps and crushing floors. Get from the entrance to the treasure room within the time its warning carving gives.
quests.reward: Agility XP, emeralds, a book of Feather Falling

quests.title: The Circle of Stones
quests.summary: A witch's circle of stones stands in the swamp under a full moon. Brew the potion carved into its stones and pour it at the centre; a witch's familiar answers.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a Book of Familiars, redstone

quests.title: Reading the Obelisks
quests.summary: Obelisks in the desert carry the same carvings in different orders. Visit three, note the carvings, and the one symbol they all share points to a cache.
quests.reward: Magic XP, sandstone and gold

quests.title: A Coin in the Sand
quests.summary: A desert wishing well is full of old coins. Drop one gold nugget in for luck, then fish out what an earlier traveller wished away.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, a gold nugget pouch, a lucky charm (luck potion)

quests.title: Under the Arches
quests.summary: Mossy stone arches stand in the swamp water with cubbies hidden under them. Search three of them for the smuggler's stash.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, slime balls, emeralds

quests.title: The Bridge Builder
quests.summary: Crossing one of the old river bridges, the player finds the builder's plaque asking for one more. Build a Macaw's bridge across another river.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, Macaw's bridge parts, logs

quests.title: Shards of the Trail
quests.summary: Trail ruins hide their past under suspicious gravel. Brush out four different pottery sherds and fit them on a decorated pot, and maybe the Relic disc turns up too.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a brush, a sniffer egg

quests.title: The Broken Gate
quests.summary: A ruined portal stands half-collapsed with crying obsidian in its frame. Find the missing obsidian and rebuild the frame, but don't light it yet: the Arcane order wants a word first.
quests.reward: Mining XP, a flint and steel, gold

quests.title: The Igloo's Basement
quests.summary: Under an igloo's carpet, a ladder leads to a cell holding a zombie villager. Cure him with weakness and a golden apple, and he tells you whose igloo it was.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a brewing stand, a golden apple

quests.title: Fresh from the Oven
quests.summary: The village bakery's baker is behind on orders. Bake a strawberry cake, a baguette and a tray of cupcakes at its station and deliver them before the festival.
quests.reward: Cooking XP, a Bakery rolling pin, bread

quests.title: Brewfest
quests.summary: A brewfest tent stands in the plains with a contest board. Brew three beers, enter the best, and beat the brewfest regulars (and the Beer Elemental they keep in the cellar).
quests.reward: Cooking XP, a brewfest hat, a wooden brewing station

quests.title: Fondue at the Chalet
quests.summary: The alpine chalet's cook makes fondue for climbers. Bring cheese of three kinds from Meadow's animals and cook the fondue together.
quests.reward: Cooking XP, Meadow cheese, fur boots

quests.title: The Alpine Chapel
quests.summary: A tiny chapel high in the meadow keeps a bell for lost climbers. Bring its keeper alpine flowers and a lantern, and ring it during a snowstorm to guide a lost shepherd in.
quests.reward: Agility XP, an oil lantern, Meadow wool

quests.title: Stones of the Meadow
quests.summary: Stone monuments stand across the alpine meadows. Visit three and leave an offering of flowers at each.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, Meadow flowers, limestone

quests.title: The Observation Post
quests.summary: An alpine observation post has a camera on its sill and a list of animals to sight. Photograph three of them (a water buffalo, a horned sheep and an eagle-eyed bird) with Meadow's camera.
quests.reward: Range XP, a Meadow camera, a spyglass

quests.title: The Gardener's Cottage
quests.summary: A cottage in the woods with a garden gone wild. Talk to the wandering gardener who lives there, help replant her beds with BloomingNature flowers and earn a cutting of each.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, BloomingNature flowers, a flower box

quests.title: The Little House in the Woods
quests.summary: A tiny house in the forest has a shopping list nailed to its door. Fetch what's on it from the woods around and leave it by the door; something leaves a gift in return overnight.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, honey, a fairy sighting

quests.title: The Gingerbread House
quests.summary: A gingerbread house in the snow, and a gingerbread golem that won't let anyone eat the walls. Bake it some gingerbread cookies and eggnog to win it over.
quests.reward: Cooking XP, a sled, candy canes

quests.title: The Butterfly Lovers
quests.summary: A lonely grave where two butterflies always circle. Read the legend on it, catch a pair of matching butterflies and release them at the grave.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a butterfly net, flowers

quests.title: Somebody's Camp
quests.summary: An abandoned campsite has chests left unguarded. One of them is a mimic; beat it and see what it swallowed.
quests.reward: Attack XP, a lantern, campfire food

quests.title: Bring Them Home
quests.summary: A skeleton in armour lies where an adventurer fell. Take the name tag and gear found on it to the nearest village and tell the family, who have a gift for the one who brought news.
quests.reward: Defense XP, the adventurer's sword (renamed)

quests.title: Stones That Remember
quests.summary: Activating a wild waystone for the first time starts it. Find and attune five waystones, then make a warp scroll and use it.
quests.reward: Agility XP, warp scrolls, a return scroll

quests.title: Frostbitten Ruins
quests.summary: Frozen spires and an abandoned village in the snow, built by no people anyone knows. Something very large sleeps far below; the player notes it and leaves (come back after the Dragon).
quests.reward: Magic XP, a page of the old ruins' writing

quests.title: Occupied Dunes
quests.summary: A desert village has been occupied by Kobolediator scouts, and a dig site nearby goes deeper than it should. Drive the scouts off, read the foreman's notes, and leave the pit alone for now.
quests.reward: Attack XP, gold, the foreman's notes

quests.title: Back to the Ruins
quests.summary: Now the old ruins' writing makes sense: the snow ruins and the desert dig sites point to the Cataclysm's prisons. Revisit one of each and read the inscriptions that name what's buried there.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a hint toward the Cataclysm strongholds

quests.title: Petals on the Wind
quests.summary: Entering a cherry grove for the first time. Collect pink petals, a cherry sapling and honey from the grove's bees.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, cherry saplings

quests.title: Mooshroom Shores
quests.summary: Landing on a mushroom island. Find the mushroom idol that stands on some of them and milk a mooshroom for stew.
quests.reward: Farming XP, mycelium, a bowl of mushroom stew

quests.title: Lavender Haze
quests.summary: Entering a Biomes O' Plenty lavender field. Gather lavender and brew a calming tea from it.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, HerbalBrews tea

quests.title: Where It All Began
quests.summary: Stumbling into the rare Origin Valley, where the world looks as it did long ago. Collect a block of its old grass and a rose.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, a nostalgic painting

quests.title: Alpha Grove
quests.summary: Entering Regions Unexplored's alpha grove, all old-style leaves and grass. Bring back its saplings and leaves before you forget what it looked like.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, alpha saplings

quests.title: The Mystic Grove
quests.summary: Entering a mystic grove. A fairy shows itself among the glowing flowers if you wait quietly; follow it to its ring.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a fairy in a bottle

quests.title: The Ominous Woods
quests.summary: Entering the ominous woods at night, the player is hunted. Survive until dawn inside the woods, killing what comes.
quests.reward: Defense XP, a shield, torches

quests.title: Giants of the Forest
quests.summary: Entering a redwood forest (Biomes O' Plenty or Regions Unexplored). Climb a redwood to the top and bring down its wood.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, redwood logs, an axe

quests.title: The Mountain That Smokes
quests.summary: Finding a Biomes O' Plenty volcano. Reach its crater, scoop a bucket of lava and bring back black sand and magma.
quests.reward: Mining XP, a fire resistance potion, obsidian

quests.title: Hot Springs
quests.summary: Finding hot springs. Soak in the thermal water until fully healed, then take a bottle home.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a Comforts hammock

quests.title: Snowblossom
quests.summary: Entering a snowblossom grove, white petals in the snow. Collect snowblossom leaves and a sapling.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, snowblossom saplings

quests.title: The Wasteland
quests.summary: Entering a dried-out wasteland. Cross it on foot and find the dead tree at its heart.
quests.reward: Agility XP, dead wood, water

quests.title: The Pumpkin Patch
quests.summary: Entering a pumpkin patch (Biomes O' Plenty) or pumpkin fields (Regions Unexplored). Pick the biggest pumpkins and carve a jack o'lantern.
quests.reward: Farming XP, pumpkin pie

quests.title: Under the Baobabs
quests.summary: Entering a baobab savanna. Collect baobab wood and watch the herds go by.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, baobab saplings

quests.title: White Cliffs
quests.summary: Finding Regions Unexplored's chalk cliffs above the sea. Climb from the beach to the top without falling.
quests.reward: Agility XP, chalk blocks

quests.title: Among the Spires
quests.summary: Entering the stone spires (Regions Unexplored) or towering cliffs. Stand on top of the tallest spire you can find.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a grappling hook upgrade

quests.title: Magnolia in Bloom
quests.summary: Entering a magnolia woodland or glistering meadow. Gather magnolia flowers and the meadow's shining grass.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, magnolia saplings

quests.title: Ashen Woods
quests.summary: Entering the ashen woodland, burnt by an old fire. Collect ash and find a surviving sapling.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, bone meal

quests.title: Land of Cacti
quests.summary: Entering a saguaro or joshua desert. Collect saguaro cactus and a joshua tree sapling, and don't hug the cactus.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, green dye

quests.title: Above the Clouds
quests.summary: Tectonic's mountains climb far higher than vanilla. Stand above Y 300 on foot and look down on the clouds.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a spyglass, golden carrots

quests.title: The Deep Valley
quests.summary: Tectonic's rivers cut deep valleys. Follow one down to where it meets the sea and fish at its mouth.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, bait

quests.title: Ice Spikes
quests.summary: Entering an ice spikes plain. Mine packed ice from the top of a spike with silk touch.
quests.reward: Mining XP, blue ice

quests.title: The Painted Badlands
quests.summary: Entering the badlands. Collect every colour of terracotta from the canyon walls.
quests.reward: Mining XP, gold

quests.title: The Grand Tour
quests.summary: Visit twenty different Overworld biomes, a Nature's Compass helps. Each new biome is ticked on the list.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a Nature's Compass, a Sophisticated backpack upgrade

quests.title: A Song from Somewhere
quests.summary: Picking up any music disc starts it. Build a jukebox and play the disc, then learn the tune on an Immersive Melodies instrument.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a lute

quests.title: Antique Ink
quests.summary: Finding a bottle of antique ink in a chest starts it. Ink a map with it and the map shows an old landmark that isn't on new maps; go there.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a globe, an Explorer's Compass

quests.title: The Strange Key
quests.summary: Finding a lone Supplementaries key in a dungeon chest starts it. Its tag names a safe; find it in a ruin nearby and open it.
quests.reward: Mining XP, the safe's contents

quests.title: An Ancient Egg
quests.summary: Finding a sniffer egg starts it. Hatch it on moss, raise the sniffer and plant the first ancient seed it digs up.
quests.reward: Taming XP, torchflowers, a pitcher plant
